$comment: Over-the-air updates must stay rollback-safe: a device can always go back to the bundle of its store build, so an
update may never change native code, build configuration or the format of stored data. The signer on the build
machine refuses an update that changes any of these paths compared to the commit of the store build (runtime).
It reads this file at that runtime commit, so an update can never loosen its own rules. Patterns: ** is any
number of path segments, * is anything within one segment. See docs/ota-updates.md in the backend repo.

forbidden.reason: native code, native configuration and bundling: only a store build may change them
stored data formats: Realm schemas, migrations and persisted enums must stay readable by the store build
secrets: vault, encryption, passcode, biometrics and the degen-mode secret storage
the updater itself: a broken updater can not be fixed over the air
